se_page_desc: Set up your profile, schedule, verification, bank account, and notifications.
se_toast_bank_holder_required: Enter the account holder's name first.
se_toast_bank_save_failed: Failed to save the bank account. Please try again.
se_err_end_after_start: End time must be after the start time.
se_err_ktp_size: The e-KTP photo can be at most 10 MB.
se_err_ktp_format: The e-KTP photo must be JPG, PNG, or WebP, max 10 MB.
se_err_ktp_upload_failed: Failed to upload the e-KTP photo. Please try again.
se_err_ktp_generic: Couldn't submit the verification. Please try again.
se_profile_info_desc: Basic account info and the identity you use on Karja.
se_ph_name: Your name or your store name
se_name_hint: This name is used for your account.
se_ph_bio: Tell a little about your expertise and the products you offer.
se_contact_desc: Used when Karja needs to reach you, or for features that rely on WhatsApp.
se_draft_banner_desc: Connect your calendar and set your available hours, then head back to the product.
se_gcal_desc: So Karja can see conflicting times and show the slots that are still open.
se_gcal_conflict_note: Times that conflict in this calendar are skipped automatically.
se_sched_desc: Pick the days and hours buyers can book.
se_copy_day_title: Copy this day's hours to other days
se_advanced_desc: Set the break and booking limits for this Session.
se_buffer_desc: Leave some free time before the next session.
se_notice_desc: How close to the session buyers can still book.
se_id_desc: Identity verification is required before you can withdraw money.
se_status_verified_tooltip: This account's identity has been verified.
se_id_verified_desc: This account's identity has been verified. You can go ahead and set up your bank account to withdraw money.
se_id_verified_footer: You can go ahead and set up your bank account to withdraw money.
se_id_failed_default: Check the reason, then update what needs fixing.
se_pending_banner_desc: Your data is in. We'll let you know once the verification is done.
se_ph_ktp_name: Full name as shown on your e-KTP
se_upload_hint: Make sure the photo is clear and all parts of the KTP are visible.
se_upload_confirm: Make sure the data and e-KTP photo are correct before submitting.
se_badge_tooltip: Karja Verified: This account's identity and activity meet Karja's verification standards.
se_kv_desc: The Karja Verified badge is given to sellers with a verified identity who have built a transaction record on Karja.
se_kv_active_desc: The badge is shown on your store and product pages.
se_kv_revoked_default: The badge is temporarily paused due to a transaction compliance review.
se_kv_progress_desc: Complete your first order and build up transactions on Karja to unlock the Karja Verified badge.
se_req2_desc: Account registered under the account owner's name.
se_req4_desc: At least {min} different buyers, so transactions don't all come from one person.
se_req5_desc: The account operates normally with no one-sided cancellations or open disputes.
se_req6_desc: Products and service delivery follow Karja's community rules.
se_bank_desc: The money you withdraw will go to this account.
se_bank_gate_pending_desc: Once identity verification is done, you can set up your bank account to withdraw money.
se_bank_gate_desc: Once your identity is verified, you can set up your bank account to withdraw money.
se_ph_holder: Name as on the bank account
se_holder_hint: The name must match the bank account.
se_notif_desc: Choose which updates you want to receive by email.
se_notif_new_order_desc: Email whenever a new order comes in.
se_notif_update_desc: Updates when a brief comes in or results are delivered.
se_notif_new_review_desc: Email whenever there's a new review.
se_notif_payout_desc: Email once the money lands in your account.
se_notif_footer: Notifications are sent to your account email.
se_dev_desc: Manual controls for testing. Only shown in the development environment.
se_dev_reset_desc: Clear all saved data and go back to the initial state.
